thread:
incident-bot: [P1] Alert: streaming_tail_latency_p99 breached in prod/us-west-2 (p99=12.3s, baseline=1.1s) — paging oncall

maria_gonzalez: seeing it in the dashboards too — spike started ~10:02 UTC. A lot of streaming sessions are stalling mid-response. :warning:

raj_patel: rolling up quick notes — p95 ~1.4s, p99 jumped to 12s+, error-rate for streaming endpoints up 0.8% (mostly timeouts). Non-stream (sync) endpoints are fine.

olivia_chan: customer reports: "partial transcript then nothing" on SSE and websocket clients. CS flagged two enterprise customers experiencing >30s stalls. cc @customer_success_lee

customer_success_lee: confirmed — customers seeing client-side reconnects, some requests end with 504 from our proxy. They want ETA on mitigation.

sre_oncall: I'm on it. Quick checks — frontend proxy (nginx-gw) logs show a pattern of long upstream write times and 504 gateway timeouts. Sample from 10:05:26:

```
10:05:26 upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while sending request to upstream, client: 34.12.54.3, server: api.redwood, request: "GET /v1/stream/..."
```

sre_oncall: runtime metrics show an increase in per-connection write buffer growth; KV cache hit-rate steady. No recent rollouts recorded by deploy-bot since 09:30.

deploy-bot: recent deploys: service/analytics @ 09:28 (non-prod), no prod rollouts in the last 6h.

maria_gonzalez: hypothesis: slow consumers (client-side) are causing backpressure that piles up in the proxy's write queue, which then hits upstream timeouts and stalls chunking. We also have continuous-batching enabled which may increase head-of-line blocking for long responses.

raj_patel: good call. Can we triage whether it's proxy config vs runtime scheduling? Suggestions: 1) temporarily extend proxy write timeout and disable proxy buffering for streaming endpoints, 2) enable per-connection rate limit for slow consumers, 3) route heavy streaming traffic to fallback instance pool with shorter batch windows.

kevin_ops: preparing a quick change. Pushing nginx tweak to disable proxy_buffering and increase proxy_read_timeout to 90s for /v1/stream/* — will target a single gateway pack in us-west-2 to minimize blast radius. Applying now.

olivia_chan: +1 for targeted change. Also flip the runtime flag to  "low_latency_mode": true for that pool to reduce batching window to 20ms. Doing a canary on two nodes.

sre_oncall: after nginx tweak (10:12) we see fewer 504s and client reconnects down by ~60% within 2m. p99 dropped from 12.3s -> 4.8s, p95 stable. Still a tail remain at ~6-8s for a small cohort.

maria_gonzalez: running flame graphs vs serving runtime — there's a backlog in the async write loop where blocked sockets wait on epoll for long-poll clients. On our side, enabling prefix KV cache streaming helps but doesn't solve slow consumer pacing.

raj_patel: next steps: 1) customer communication draft (CS) — acknowledge mitigation and note continued monitoring, 2) create short-term rule to detect slow-consumer sessions and send early RST after threshold (configurable), 3) postmortem after full RCA.

customer_success_lee: I'll draft a message for the affected customers: explain we deployed targeted gateway changes and reduced disruptions; provide a follow-up with timeline for permanent fix.

maria_gonzalez: creating a monitoring alert for slow-consumer ratio >3% and a dashboard to break down by client version and region.

olivia_chan: opening a short-lived feature flag to auto-route heavy streaming sessions to low-latency pool. Will keep it on for 30m and roll back if any regression.

sre_oncall: handoff to second oncall @raj_pat el — I'll stay on the channel for 10m for context. Current status: mitigations applied, customer impact reduced, but tail latency still >SLO for a tiny percent.

raj_patel: taking over. I'll coordinate deeper runtime traces and a longer-term throttling design. Adding follow-up action items and assigning owners.

incident-bot: Incident P1 assigned -> leads: raj_pat el/maria_gonzalez, status: mitigated->monitoring, started_at: 2791234567, severity: P1

kevin_ops: note to ops: consider increasing proxy write buffers and revisit default proxy_buffering for streaming endpoints in next config review.

maria_gonzalez: captured logs, sample traces, and a repro script for slow-client simulation saved to the incident ticket. Will add to postmortem.

raj_patel: updated oncall runbook with temporary thresholds and RST policy. Will schedule follow-up retro after 24h.

customer_success_lee: customers updated with interim message. They'll reply if they still see issues.

sre_oncall: closing active pager. Monitoring continues. Handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
